title: Clearer permanent team changes and safer previews
summary: Roster Management keeps entered details, explains joins and leaves, and verifies future-period previews before saving.
changes: Permanent team suggestions use the applicable establishment, and changing the effective date preserves entered names and reason.
The effective-date calendar remains visible and independent of the selected clinical night, and five-person staffing guidance matches the current model.
The preview explicitly shows joining members, leaving members and Pager order; validation and save errors appear beside the form.
The separate seventh-nurse cycle keeps its existing order across period changes, with replacements inheriting the departing member’s place.
Saving prevents double submissions and disables editing until complete; changed or expired previews require a fresh review.
A future manual night plan confirmed before a permanent team change requires fresh review; earlier approvals remain preserved.
All earlier nights, existing periods and the verified 12 October Pager sequence remain preserved.
